guidedProject.title: DevPulse: Personal Developer Portfolio
guidedProject.description:
Build a beginner-friendly personal portfolio with reusable components and separate JSON data.

Learning sequence:
1. Render a Hero section.
2. Pass name/title as props.
3. Move project data into projects.json.
4. Map the data into ProjectCard components.
5. Add a stable key.
6. Keep the UI components independent from the data source.
7. Prepare the finished project for GitHub.

codeStudio.title: Personal Developer Portfolio Showcase
codeStudio.description:
Build a small portfolio using a real multi-file component tree and a separate JSON data file.

The key learning goal is data flow:
projects.json → App.jsx → ProjectList → ProjectCard

You will also practice default exports, imports, arrays, `.map()`, stable keys, props, and reusable components.

Use the provided JSON as the source of project data instead of hard-coding each card in the component.

tasks.failMessage: Expected TaskFlow Manager in the rendered project list.
